result.summary: The page is generally intact, but the “Fastest near you” section shows the same restaurant card duplicated side-by-side, which looks like a content/rendering defect rather than intentional variety.

issues.description: Two identical “Green Bowl Poké” cards appear next to each other with the same image, delivery time, and delivery fee, making the carousel look duplicated or broken.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate restaurant results server-side or in the UI list rendering logic; if the duplicate represents multiple locations, differentiate the card with location/branch info or merge them into one entry.
